name: Aranyosgadány (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Aranyosgadány (a shield of red and blue with ears of grain, a plough and a wing) between a wreath of grain and oak, with the name ARANYOSGADÁNY in black above and a red scroll below.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Aranyosgadány arms with wreath and scroll
